a: Yes, I do. It can help me reduce stress and recharge my batteries. Travelling also helps me gain new knowledge and make new friends.

q: Do you prefer travelling alone or with a group of people?
a:
I prefer travelling with a group of people because it's safer and cheaper than travelling alone. It's also a good way to make new friends and share experiences with them.

或者：
I prefer travelling alone because it is more relaxing and gives me more freedom. Travelling alone also gives me more time to explore local attractions and interact with the locals.

q: What kinds of souvenirs do tourists buy in your country?
a: They buy a variety of souvenirs, such as T-shirts, toys and jewellery. Stamps and postcards are also popular souvenirs.
vocab: 首饰，注意：它是不可数名词，不能加 s

q: Do you think it's important for us to go on holiday?
a: Yes, it's important for us to go on holiday at least once or twice a year. It's a good way to reduce stress and recharge our batteries.
vocab: get away from my daily routine
暂时离开我的日常生活惯例

q: Do you think there should be more public holidays?
a:
Yes, that's probably a good idea. Many people travel on public holidays and they spend money on transport, accommodation and entertainment, which can contribute to the economy.

或者：
Definitely. For example, Teachers' Day should become a public holiday. It would be a great way to honour teachers' contribution to society.
vocab: 向教师们为社会所做的贡献表示敬意

q: When you travel, do you prefer to stay at a hotel that has a beautiful view?
a: Honestly, that's not an important factor for me when choosing a hotel. I usually don't spend much time in the hotel room when I travel.
vocab: not an important factor for me
对我来说不是一个重要的因素

q: Do you like to take photos of beautiful scenery?
a: Definitely. I love taking pictures of beautiful scenery, like beaches, islands or mountains. And I enjoy sharing the photos with my family and friends.

q: Would you like to live near the sea?
a: Yes, I'd like to. I would be able to spend a lot of my free time on the beach. The view of the sea, the sea breeze and the sound of waves would be very enjoyable and relaxing.
vocab: 令人愉快而且让人放松的

q: Would you like to live on an island?
a: Not really. The cost of living would be quite high, and I would feel bored very soon. But I'd like to go on holiday on an island.
vocab: enjoy the sun and fresh air
享受阳光和新鲜的空气

q: Why do some people like to live near rivers, lakes or the sea?
a: I suppose they prefer a view of water. And living near rivers, lakes or the sea means that they can have fun on the beach or go swimming whenever they want to.
vocab: 生活在更接近大自然的地方

q: What are the functions of rivers and lakes nowadays?
a: They're still popular places for a variety of leisure activities, like swimming, fishing and rowing. They are also an important source of fresh water. Some rivers are used for the transport of goods as well.
vocab: an important source of fresh water
重要的淡水水源，注意：在地道英文里 fresh water 不是指新鲜的水，而是指“淡水”
